findings.text: The specification assumes SQLite reports the newest index first, but SQLite puts indexes declared with `ON CONFLICT REPLACE` last even under `INSERT OR ABORT`, so duplicate `(1,1)` rows in `t(a UNIQUE, b UNIQUE ON CONFLICT REPLACE)` report `t.a`, contrary to that rule ([SQLite source](https://www3.sqlite.org/matrix/ev/src/insert.html)). Fix: qualify the ordering claim to account for declared conflict algorithms and UPSERT precedence before selecting a diagnostic.
